messages:
eli: Cutover heads-up: canary deploy for rc-9 in ~45m (UTC scheduled). Need 2x LGTM on the hotfix PRs before cutoff or we'll fallback to previous canary. PRs: #8129 (kv-cache cherry-pick), #8134 (sigterm retry). @kevin @marta can you take first pass? @nisha willing to be backup reviewer? :pray:
kevin: On it — grabbing #8129 now. Quick Q: did CI run with the quant patch? last run showed a flake on long-seq tests.
marta: I'll take #8134. ETA ~25m. If I see anything blocking I'll call for rollback.
nisha: Happy to be shadow. If you need the 2nd LGTM and you're blocked, ping me and I can do a quick sanity check.
jun: Are we doing canary in us-west first? Need to confirm KV warm-up script is included in the build.
releases-bot: deploy-bot: CI status — #8129: all checks passed. #8134: integration failing (timeout test_inference). https://ci.example/PR/8134
kevin: Reproducing #8134 flaky timeout locally now. If it's just a test timeout we can rerun, but want to avoid masking a legit regression.
marta: Rerun queued. If it clears with >15m left we'll proceed. If not, propose we cut only #8129 and hold #8134.
eli: Plan B approved: ship #8129 if it gets 2x LGTM + passing CI. I'll update release notes and set fallback policy to roll to prev model-config.
nisha: :thumbsup: I'll stand by for quick LGTM on #8129 once kevin finishes review.
kevin: Left a couple nits on #8129 (doc string, one log level). No functional blockers. :white_check_mark:
marta: Rerun for #8134 failed again (same timeout). don't want to force it. holding.
eli: OK locking cut logic: waiting on 1 more LGTM for #8129. @nisha can you give final sanity check? If no objections I'll cut in 10m.
nisha: Pulled the diff & ran a short smoke locally against a small model, KV warm-up looks consistent. giving LGTM. :heavy_check_mark:
eli: Great — we have 2x LGTM. Cutting canary in 5m. I'll watch metrics and have rollback ready.
jun: Confirming us-west primary, understood. I'll watch warmup logs and surface any regressions.
releases-bot: deploy-bot: Canary cut initiated by eli at 3649123750. Monitor: https://monitoring.example/canary/rc-9
kevin: Watching logs — small CPU spike at pod init but KV warming smoothing out.
marta: Thanks team. If anything degrades, call the #release-rollback channel immediately.
eli: Thanks all. If canary is healthy in 20m we'll proceed with wider rollout. I'll post a short summary to #release-notes after 30m.
